requirementsManagement.architectureImpact: Nineteen ABBs, five stakeholder views and ten proposed architecture decisions provide full target coverage.
requirementsManagement.openControlImpact: Seven owner-bound controls constrain later evidence or SBB choices and remain open without waiver.
requirementsManagement.changeProtocol: Return infeasibility, weakened boundaries or changed intent through AFF-1 and AFF-0 governance; never edit Phase 1 from Phase 2.

scope.admTailoring: Combined target-depth TOGAF Phases A–D with continuous requirements management.
included: Logical Technology, Security, Operations and Resilience Architecture
excluded: Azure services, SKUs, regions, CIDRs, modules or landing-zone resources

stakeholderConcerns.concern: Reduce cycle time without weakening quality.
Retain human investment authority and required approvals.
Use only governed, lawful, classified and traceable evidence.
Meet approved sovereignty, transfer, privacy and legal-jurisdiction outcomes.
Produce supportable regulatory and AI-governance evidence without unsupported claims.
Preserve independent validation and trustworthy acceptance evidence.
Operate isolated, observable, performant and recoverable services.
Control eligibility, rollout and incremental transition.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: Case and Eligibility Management
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Control case identity, the 20-deal boundary, eligibility, workflow state and outcome timestamps.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: Governed Source Connectivity
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Provide approved read-only APIs or controlled source access without AI-generated write-back.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: Controlled Ingestion
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Quarantine content and enforce owner, classification, purpose and admission controls.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: Evidence and Provenance
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Maintain evidence envelopes, source lineage, ownership, timestamps, licence and quality status.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: Assistive Analysis
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Perform retrieval, extraction, comparison, anomaly, risk and ESG analysis within approved AI boundaries.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: Grounding and Citation
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Bind every material claim to accessible governed source evidence.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: Human Review and Approval
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Enforce deal-professional validation and applicable Legal and Compliance approval.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: Decision Rights Guardrail
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Keep outputs draft-only, prevent prohibited actions and retain Investment Committee authority.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: Data Governance and Lifecycle
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Apply minimisation, classification, authoritative schedules, legal holds and working-copy disposition.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: Policy Decision and Enforcement
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Evaluate and enforce purpose, location, transfer, data-use, classification and legal control decisions.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: Identity and Privileged Access
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Provide controlled identities, least privilege, EU-based operation, time-bound elevation and emergency access.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: Audit Evidence
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Correlate and protect material business, data, AI, access, review and control evidence.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: Observability and Incident Management
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Provide metrics, logs, traces, critical-alert monitoring and named incident ownership.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: Resilience and Recovery
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Protect recoverable case, evidence, policy and audit state and support continuity evidence.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: Environment and Data Isolation
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Separate development, test and production and restrict production-confidential data to production.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: Quality Evaluation and Independent Validation
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Provide benchmark, negative-test, performance and independent verdict evidence boundaries.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: External Data Licence Gate
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Block external data until licence and AI-assisted-use permission are approved.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: Legal and Regulatory Evidence
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Maintain approved privacy, SFDR, AIFMD, AI-governance, DORA-aligned and jurisdiction evidence without unsupported claims.

architectureBuildingBlocks.name: Workload and Performance Management
architectureBuildingBlocks.responsibility: Control interactive and document-pack workloads against approved performance and business objectives.

architectureDecisions.title: Case-centred control spine
architectureDecisions.decision: Use a case-centred workflow to bind eligibility, evidence, review, timestamps and rollout.
architectureDecisions.rationale: One governed case identity provides the control and measurement boundary required by the business outcome.
implications: Every material event carries a case identifier.
Eligibility and rollout state are auditable.

architectureDecisions.title: Preserve authoritative source boundary
architectureDecisions.decision: Use read-only source connectivity or controlled ingestion and prohibit AI-generated write-back.
architectureDecisions.rationale: This preserves source integrity and the approved system-of-record boundary.
implications: Source permissions deny AI writes.
Connector evidence is required.

architectureDecisions.title: Mandatory evidence envelope
architectureDecisions.decision: Require a classified evidence envelope with provenance, owner, timestamp, licence and quality status.
architectureDecisions.rationale: Complete metadata is necessary for lawful use, reproducibility, citation and audit.
implications: Incomplete evidence is unavailable to analysis.
Derived items retain lineage.

architectureDecisions.title: Separate analysis from authority
architectureDecisions.decision: Separate assistive analysis from human review, specialist approval and investment decisions.
architectureDecisions.rationale: The approved AI boundary is assistive and requires accountable human authority.
alternatives: Advisory output without enforced review gates
implications: Outputs remain drafts.
Analysis cannot advance required approval state.

architectureDecisions.title: Common policy decisions with boundary enforcement
architectureDecisions.decision: Use logically common policy decisions enforced at admission, access, analysis, review and transfer boundaries.
architectureDecisions.rationale: Consistent fail-closed decisions reduce control divergence across channels and workloads.
implications: Missing approval or evidence blocks progression.
Decision and enforcement evidence is correlated.

architectureDecisions.title: Environment and data trust separation
architectureDecisions.decision: Treat development, test and production as separate logical trust and data boundaries.
architectureDecisions.rationale: This enforces the approved environment and production-confidential data boundary.
implications: Non-production uses synthetic data.
Access and evidence are environment-specific.

architectureDecisions.title: Separate interactive and document-pack work
architectureDecisions.decision: Separate interactive requests from controlled document-pack work at the logical level.
architectureDecisions.rationale: The two workloads have distinct latency, duration, progress and failure characteristics.
implications: Work admission, progress and failure are observable.
Technology choice remains deferred.

architectureDecisions.title: Recover complete trustworthy service state
architectureDecisions.decision: Protect case, evidence, audit and policy records as recoverable service state.
architectureDecisions.rationale: Recovery is trustworthy only when operational and control state remains consistent.
implications: Each state class requires RTO/RPO and integrity evidence.
Recovery includes control consistency.

architectureDecisions.title: Independent validation evidence boundary
architectureDecisions.decision: Prevent delivery and operations from issuing or modifying the Internal Audit verdict.
architectureDecisions.rationale: The approved validator must remain organisationally and evidentially independent.
implications: Model Risk advises methods only.
Internal Audit receives read-only complete evidence and issues the verdict.

architectureDecisions.title: External data quarantine
architectureDecisions.decision: Quarantine external data until licence, purpose and AI-use permission pass.
architectureDecisions.rationale: Pre-use enforcement avoids unlicensed or unlawful analysis.
implications: External content cannot reach analysis before approval.
Licence changes can suspend use.

aff3HandoffConstraints: Map every selected Solution Building Block to one or more approved ABBs and requirements.
Do not weaken human authority, source authority, fail-closed policy or Internal Audit independence.
Do not infer Azure regions; consume the General Counsel-approved EU/EEA list after VAL-005.
Keep evidence stores, databases, integration and administrative paths logically private.
Preserve Stratton-controlled identity, EU-based privileged operation, least privilege, time-bound elevation, emergency access and audit.
Evidence that provider and model terms prohibit foundation-model training with Stratton data.
Preserve read-only source connectivity and licence-gated external ingestion.
Treat VAL-002 and VAL-004 as design dependencies for performance, operations and capacity.
Make no formal DORA or AI Act classification claim while the corresponding residual controls remain open.
Return infeasible requirements or weakened boundaries through governed architecture change.
